title: Marconi radar and the Italian crash

tellings.quote:
not
just in Cape
Gerardo but maybe in Italy as well
because Marone was involved

plain: John Blitch, a researcher who says he has had his own encounters, talked about it with podcast host Jesse Michels in 2025. He suggests that a crashed object may have been found not just at Cape Girardeau in the United States but also in northern Italy, before the Second World War. His reason is that Guglielmo Marconi, the Italian radio pioneer, was involved, which would mean the story of recovered craft reaches back further and wider than usually told.
